blockers_found_by_code_reading: App client and room server speak different wire protocols: path /omo-room/v1/ws vs /ws; frame key t vs type; hello.auth{kind} vs hello.token; welcome+join+room vs single welcome; invite link /omo-room/join/<room>#invite= vs /join#invite=; roles owner|member vs viewer|member|builder|owner. The app cannot connect to omo/server at all.
Owner 'host' flow in the app expects the server to create a room from an owner token; omo/server only accepts omo1.* room keys from create-room.
Build mode WorldStore writes browser localStorage only; RemoteWorldSource (remote-room-controller.ts) is never wired, so owner edits are never sent to the room.
VoiceHub.useTransport(remoteRoomVoiceTransport(...)) is never called; remote voice uses the local-presence transport via RoutedPresenceService instead of the designed remote transport.
Existing remote-room probes use a MOCK server written to the client's protocol, so the mismatch was never caught.
